plan.title: bug(scope): a verb discussed in issue prose becomes a stated acceptance command and blocks scope:complete

narratives.Description: bug(scope): a verb discussed in issue prose becomes a stated acceptance command and blocks scope:complete
narratives.Overview:
> **Recut after an N=3 panel.** The original filing blamed a critic's fenced quote and a live comment re-read at completion. Three critics independently refuted that and the parent reproduced the refutation. Trail: A [5411963665](https://github.com/deftai/directive/issues/3721#issuecomment-5411963665), B [5412022913](https://github.com/deftai/directive/issues/3721#issuecomment-5412022913), C [5411938754](https://github.com/deftai/directive/issues/3721#issuecomment-5411938754), parent correction [5411959179](https://github.com/deftai/directive/issues/3721#issuecomment-5411959179), successor lean [5412056367](https://github.com/deftai/directive/issues/3721#issuecomment-5412056367), verified claims [5412056624](https://github.com/deftai/directive/issues/3721#issuecomment-5412056624).

## Problem

A verb *discussed* in an issue becomes a command *claimed* as that story's acceptance, and blocks `scope:complete` until someone promotes it.

`issue:ingest` concatenates the whole thread — body plus every comment — into `plan.narratives.Overview`. For #3712 that is **64,336 characters**. The literal-AC extractor then re-scans that prose at completion and treats inline-backticked verb mentions as stated acceptance commands requiring a promoted peer.

## Observed

#3712 merged as `b1aa8cea`, issue closed. `scope:complete` with valid delivery and per-item acceptance evidence:

```
Literal acceptance-command gate FAILED (#3267): 3 stated command(s) are
capture-only (source=task_statement) and have no matching agent-promoted peer.
  - command="deft verify:*"                  (source=task_statement)
  - command="task check"                     (source=task_statement)
  - command="task verify:scope-provenance"   (source=task_statement)
```

Provenance of each, located in `Overview`:

| Command | Overview line | Origin |
|---|---|---|
| `task check` | 29 | issue body — prose citing `run: task check:merge` in a CI file |
| `deft verify:*` | 45 | issue body — prose naming which verbs a clause covers |
| `task verify:scope-provenance` | 260 | a critic comment — prose stating what the critic did *not* run |

None of the three is an acceptance criterion for #3712, which is a one-sentence documentation correction. The third is a critic explicitly saying it did **not** run the command.

## Not the fence path

`#3511` already demoted fence-derived captures to advisory. The same run prints:

```
Literal acceptance advisory (#3484): 25 prose/fence-derived capture(s) were
safety-rejected but do NOT block
```

Excluding fenced blocks would change nothing here. That fix is already in and is not the gap.

## Why the printed remedy is not acceptable as-is

The error says to promote the exact strings into `plan.metadata.swarm.verify_commands`. For a documentation fix, declaring `task check` as the story's verification asserts something untrue in order to clear a red gate — the #3156 failure mode. An operator under pressure to unblock a cohort will do it anyway, which makes the promotion path a laundering route for false acceptance evidence.

## Scaling

The defect grows with discussion. A heavily-critiqued issue accumulates a larger `Overview`, so the more rigorously a design is reviewed, the more spurious captures its story carries into completion. Two of the three captures here came from the recut body a critique arc produced.

## Scope note

Severity is lower than the original filing claimed. B measured **3 of 6** cohort briefs reproducing the failure, not all six. The parent's attempt to predict from stored metadata returned 0 of 6 and is invalid, so the count is endorsed rather than independently confirmed. The `BLOCKER` title and `adoption-blocker` label were applied on the refuted mechanism and should be reconsidered as part of this work.

## Candidate directions

Not selecting one.

- Give `task_statement` captures the same advisory demotion `#3511` gave fenced ones, so prose mentions warn rather than block.
- Narrow capture at the source: an inline backtick inside a prose sentence is a reference, not a stated command. Require a stronger signal.
- Stop concatenating the entire comment thread into `Overview`, or exclude the comment portion from literal-AC scanning while keeping it for context (#2143).
- Keep the block but make promotion honest: let an operator record a capture as *not an acceptance command* without asserting it is one.

## Also confirmed, worth fixing alongside

`scope:complete --help` lists only `<file>` and `--project-root`. `--merge-commit` and `--pr` are required for any code-bearing completion and appear nowhere. All three critics found this independently.

## Acceptance

- [ ] A verb mentioned in issue or comment prose does not, by itself, become a stated acceptance command that blocks completion
- [ ] Where a capture is genuinely uncertain, the operator can disposition it without asserting it is an acceptance command
- [ ] The fix does not blanket-exclude fenced blocks — that path is already advisory and is not the defect
- [ ] `scope:complete --help` lists `--merge-commit` and `--pr`
- [ ] Regression coverage: a brief whose `Overview` contains backticked verb prose completes without promotion
- [ ] No gate weakened beyond the identified false-positive class (#3156)
- [ ] Title and labels revised to match the measured blast radius
- [ ] CHANGELOG `[Unreleased]` entry

Refs #3267, #3484, #3511, #2143, #3476.

The reproduction is real and I hit it live: #3712 merged as `b1aa8cea`, issue closed, and `scope:complete` refused with a rejected candidate that exists only inside a critic's fenced quote on the issue thread — not in the xBRIEF.

**Evidence:** `extractFromFences` deliberately captures shell-shaped fence bodies (`capture.ts:262-354`); labeled lines and inline spans **outside** fences are captured separately. - `scope:complete` calls `evaluateLiteralAcceptanceFromPlan` with `captureFromNarratives: true` (`transition.ts` 293–298). The unlabeled fence is at lines 405–408. Capture stamps `fence@L405` (fence *open* line, `capture.ts` 281–285). Parent’s “line 388 of body+comments” vs `L405` is the compose header (`---`, thread heading, italic #2143 note, per-comment `###` headers), not a live fetch.

**What actually fails.** After partition, `resolved.rejected` (blocking) is **[]**. The Allowlist row is in `advisoryRejected` (count **25**), span `fence@L405`, reason `shell metacharacter "{" is not allowed in literal AC commands`. 1. `deft verify:*` — already stored at ingest (`inline@L47`, body).
2. `task check` — `inline@L119`, critic prose in the thread suffix (“executes `task check`”).
3. `task verify:scope-provenance` — `inline@L260`, critic footnote (“I did not run `task verify:scope-provenance`”).

`extractInlineVerifySpans` lifts backtick spans on any line that also matches `verify|run|execute|acceptance`, and it **already skips fence bodies** (`capture.ts` 457–476). Excluding fences would not have removed (2) or (3).

**Injection / swarm lens (triggered: untrusted input + a fail-closed gate + ambient authority).** Overview is agent-facing scope authority. A critic (or any commenter) who writes `task check` in backticks on a line that also says “verify” becomes a capture-only AC row at complete.
